input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
errors: First background build was started with a shell '&' in a foreground call; it survived, but run_in_background is the reliable form.
PIL in the system python3 is broken (no _imaging); used Playwright setContent to compose before/after images instead.

doc_friction.issue: Picking from 'Still weakest' means reading 25 polish reports from the last two days; there is no index of open items across them, so the same carried-over items (hub's empty margin) repeat in many files.
The harness blocks `sleep N; cmd`; platform/ci/wait_for.py is the right tool and is named only in the polish prompt.

deviations.why: Final measurements came from regenerating pf-jobs.css/js and the status text into dist/ from the final jobs.mjs, not from a second full 10-minute build after the wording change.
deviations.did: Same render functions the build calls; the full build of the first draft plus check.mjs and 1,740 page tests on the final code.
deviations.result: Numbers stated with that caveat in the report.

notes: Saved-bids band on 168 bid calculators now opens with 'Save bids, mark them won or lost.' (markup + script). 390px: on button row 145/168, band grew only on the 33 copy-link pages (+26px, sentence takes its own row so buttons stay together); 1280px: 168/168, 0 grew, 0 sideways scroll. check.mjs: 10,697 pages, no dead links. node --test platform/pages/*.test.mjs: 1740 pass, 0 fail. jobs.test.mjs 243 pass.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: measure 168 pages at two widths, wording fit test, code + tests, write-up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
